name: severity-badge
title: Severity Badge
description: Labeled multi-level severity indicator. Maps a Severity level (ok/warning/alert/no_data/unknown/paused — langfuse MonitorSeverity vocabulary, lowercased) to a Badge variant, with a human-readable default label. Per-severity variant/label overrides via props; unmapped values fall back to the neutral outline variant. Composes the Badge primitive — not a status dot (distinct from StatusIndicator).
